exposure: timing of introduction of solid food
Timing of introduction of solid food
Birth weight classification (small, normal, or large for gestational age)
outcome: Prevalence of obesity or being overweight at 7 years of age
cohort: 100 preterm infants admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Section of the Policlinico University Hospital of Bari, Italy, between 2009 and 2011
finding: The prevalence of EAR in the cohort of preterm newborns was 54% at seven years of age, and EAR was associated with being large for gestational age (LGA) at birth.
